item.title: Interpret a Cartoon About Equal Entrances
item.prompt_text: A cartoon has two panels. In the first, a manager proudly shows three visitors identical keys. In the second, the visitors stand before doors reached by a short ramp, a long staircase and a narrow passage. Someone says the cartoon is only asking for different keys. Write an interpretation that fairly explains that reading, uses both panels, and proposes a wider question the cartoon leaves open.
item.audience: readers of an illustrated community magazine
item.target_grammar: Concession, interpretation of visual analogy, and explicit limits on an analogy.
item.target_structure: Describe what makes the simple reading plausible, analyse the second panel, and name one implication the cartoon cannot decide by itself.

checklist.point: Explain why a viewer might focus on the keys.
Use the different routes to support another interpretation.
Distinguish equal provision from the ability to use it.
Identify a further real question the picture leaves open.
